verses.html: A Song of degrees. When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
verses.text: A Song of degrees. When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
verses.title: A Song of degrees.

verses.html: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.
verses.text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.

verses.html: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
verses.text: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

verses.html: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.
verses.text: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.

verses.html: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

verses.html: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
verses.text: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
